actions.round.pause: approved member; safe pause ignores stale epoch
actions.support.pulse: CAR_HOST; battle gate required; supplies >=1 required and consumed; 5 seconds damage 3; 0 => SUPPLY_REQUIRED
actions.fire: approved passenger; current epoch, gate and sector checked
actions.mobile.collect: Approved passenger + passengerConfirmed true; independent of vehicle/battle gate and roomEpoch. Fixed DEMO_PICKUP fixtures only, no GPS verification.

angles.coordinate: vehicle relative, -180..180 inclusive; 0 front, +90 right, -90 left, +/-180 rear
angles.overlap: intentional; sectors are game design, not physical ballistics
angles.rearBoundary: Both -180 and +180 are the same rear boundary and allowed for both rear seats

seatEvidence.SENSOR: reported OCCUPIED; not independent identity proof
seatEvidence.MANUAL_UNKNOWN: manual host approved mapping; occupancy UNKNOWN or no signal
seatEvidence.EMPTY: Current or last EMPTY remains locked across UNKNOWN/missing; new OCCUPIED or explicit host allowManualUnknown approval while current UNKNOWN can release

requirements: vehicle.report no more than 6 seconds old
gate.unknown: fail closed for UX/gear; never infer charge from switch or port-open
gate.safety: vehicle must stop locally before waiting for server response
gate.reportSequence: Native client increments reportSeq per socket; server rejects non-increasing provided seq. Missing seq is legacy demo receipt-order only.

limitations: single-instance SQLite checkpoint, not a replicated database or global cross-room economy
createDemoServer() without dbPath/stateStore is ephemeral; CLI defaults to SQLite and requires a durable data directory
HTTP/WS debug only on loopback by default; public HTTPS/WSS deployment is separate infrastructure work
CAR_HOST self-enrollment is a closed-demo shortcut, not production vehicle authentication
no physical GPS attestation, live charger integration, global territory, production physics/AI or logout/refresh/deletion endpoints yet
vehicle data is an untrusted client report; server authority covers game rules
DEMO_PICKUP fixtures have no coordinates; world APIs check reported location without proving physical presence
observer reconstructs server state; no Android/vehicle pixel stream, camera or microphone capture
wave: All three targets dead => CLEARED and new epoch; explicit host round.start resets HP
pendingProjection: Only own pending member; vehicle states redacted UNKNOWN, other members and zombies hidden, stats zero
collectionEligibility: Host-approved passenger seat role plus phone self-declaration only; not live vehicle-seat or driver identity proof. No car VHAL/location relay for moving collection.

worldPolicy.storage: Configured SQLite checkpoint persists claims/receipts/inventory; raw phone position and temporary quality summaries are not persisted or broadcast.
worldPolicy.claimResult: locationValidated indicates reported input checks only; hardwareAttested false; emulator source => MOCK_DEMO

persistence.restart: PLAYING -> PAUSED; unsafe vehicle values reset; existing token/room reconnect, fresh report and explicit host start
persistence.saveFailure: STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE503; health503 ok:false; no new success/broadcast; restart from committed checkpoint

firstMessage.token: operator key or own-room host token

observer.auth: operator key selects any room read-only; host session restricted to approved host membership
observer.operatorConfig: observerToken option / ZRIDE_OBSERVER_TOKEN env; disabled by default
observer.tokenHandling: Authorization header / first WS JSON only; key stays in browser memory, not URL/storage/logs

closeCodes.4403: wrong room/role or attempted game command

teamAccess.enrollmentKeyConfig: testAccessKey option / ZRIDE_TEST_ACCESS_KEY env; empty disables for local fixtures
teamAccess.keyUse: Only POST /api/session body.accessKey. Subsequent APIs and /ws use issued opaque session Bearer token. Separate ZRIDE_OBSERVER_TOKEN remains read-only.
teamAccess.health: Public health omits room count and identities
teamAccess.transport: HTTP/WS prototype supports team test connectivity; HTTPS/WSS required for confidentiality and browser GPS secure context. Never place keys in URL.
teamAccess.gameBrowserOrigins: Absent Origin for non-browser clients, same request Host with http/https, or programmatic allowedOrigins allow-list; unrelated browser origins denied

vehicleEffects.status: implemented semantic intent API; native HVAC/light executor not implemented

executionReport.observedValue: optional finite number, boolean or null; APPLIED_CONFIRMED requires non-null

vehicleEffects.authorization: HTTP mutations require host bearer AND the current authenticated host socket; enabled session, PLAYING and fresh P/UX/foreground gate required before emitting intents; only the current host socket reports physical execution
vehicleEffects.intensity: virtualSpeedMps 0..100; DRIVE_WIND=min(speed/30,1)*maxIntensity01; other cues clamped to configured intensity cap
vehicleEffects.persistence: No effect session, pending physical intent, report or replay receipt is checkpointed. Never replay on reconnect/restart.
vehicleEffects.ackMeaning: RECEIVED/DISPATCHED are not actual actuator confirmation; APPLIED_CONFIRMED is client-reported get/callback state, not hardware attestation
vehicleEffects.observedValue: finite number, boolean or null; APPLIED_CONFIRMED requires a non-null value
vehicleEffects.expiry: Individual effect TTL expiration stops that channel; opt-in session remains enabled until invalidated or stopped
vehicleEffects.executionRule: Only new current-host WS vehicle.effect.intent may execute. Never execute REST data.intents, GET effects.active, room/observer snapshots or retry responses.

sessionScope.vehicleConnectionId: required on enabled=true; use the current CAR_HOST auth.ok field, never a room/game snapshot
sessionScope.expectedControlVersion: required on enabled=true; use latest GET effects.controlVersion; increments on enable/invalidation and each new explicit stop/disable, even already disabled
sessionScope.effectSessionId: required in scene/cue; binds even a delayed first delivery to the exact enabled effect session

vehicleEffects.gameSceneAuthority: When heist-demo-v1 has opted-in active effects, sceneId and virtual speed derive from server game state; manual /effects/scene returns GAME_SCENE_MANAGED. Generic COOP retains manual demo input.

serverState.lifecycle: room.state is authoritative: LOBBY/READY/PLAYING/PAUSED/CLEARED; game stage is a scenario substate, not a competing lifecycle
serverState.stateConcurrency: configure/advance/interact bind roomEpoch and expectedGameRevision; driver input binds current driverSessionId and monotonic inputSeq, not per-tick revision
serverState.persistence: Logical game/scenario/roles/objective progress and logical idempotency records persist; driver controls/speed/session/tick and cabin/effect authority reset on restart
serverState.clock: No offline progress catch-up. Virtual movement only while current game, driver lease and vehicle gate allow it.
serverState.gameSnapshot: RoomSnapshot.game for approved members; current driverSessionId only to host; no such state to pending phones
serverState.cabinSnapshot: RoomSnapshot.cabin for approved members; claimed SDK/source/availability/freshness, not independent vehicle attestation
serverState.transport: Game configure/input/advance/interact are REST POSTs; /ws broadcasts room snapshots. vehicle.cabin.report is a distinct current-car WS message.
serverState.driverAuthority: Current host snapshot only exposes a non-null driverSessionId. Fresh input uses roomEpoch+driverSessionId+monotonic inputSeq; held input expires after default 2000 ms. PHONE driverSessionId is null.
serverState.motion: Server tick caps elapsed step at 250 ms by default; max virtual speed 30 m/s. Revision tracks logical mutations, motionSeq tracks motion snapshots. No wall-clock/offline catch-up.
serverState.missionRunId: Persisted UUID changes on configure; sceneId is missionRunId:stageId. Configure keeps logical revision monotonic.
serverState.idempotency: Logical configure/advance/interact receipts persist separately from physical effects and driver input. Receipt data must not contain driverSessionId or transient driver controls.
serverState.battleStageGuard: heist fire/support.pulse are allowed only in DEFEND; otherwise GAME_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE. Killing the wave preserves PLAYING until mission COMPLETE; round.start after COMPLETE returns MISSION_COMPLETE until configure. Heist start/resume also requires approved connected non-EMPTY phone seats covering all remaining defense target angles; otherwise HEIST_CREW_REQUIRED (409). The initial preset needs REAR_LEFT and REAR_RIGHT; mission role names do not change seat firing sectors.

cabin.currentConnectionBinding: vehicleConnectionId from current CAR_HOST auth.ok; increasing reportSeq per connection
cabin.observation: Each observation has sampleSeq, availability, measuredAgeMs and source. AVAILABLE requires typed value/age/source; unavailable must not assert values.
cabin.freshness: Same sampleSeq and same value is cached, not a fresh measurement. Older sequence and changed-value reuse are rejected. Ordinary vehicle heartbeat cannot revive stale observations.
cabin.derived: Gate and freshness-qualified fanInput01, purificationInputEligible, approved-seat crew ready and beltProtection. AIRFLOW 4D output disables purification input eligibility. These derived fields do not grant inventory resources.
cabin.persistence: No cabin observations or derived authority stored in SQLite; restart/reconnect clears to UNKNOWN

placesParties.catalog: Git v3 manifest: 17923 OSM objects, hash-verified local shards; import-github-places.mjs; stable osm IDs; pending/disabled unless separate persisted review
placesParties.route: 128 points,20km max segment,500km max length,30min TTL; route geometry is never persisted or public; successful updates broadcast a room snapshot with the new routeRevision/source/active metadata to approved party members; geometry stays private
placesParties.invite: HOST URL fragment capability,120s,3 uses,rotated/revoked on new invite/disband/restart; only pending PHONE sessions
placesParties.lifecycle: pending leave, approved leave, host remove, host disband; no automatic host migration; transient disconnect keeps party
placesParties.shared: world.subscribe / world.unsubscribe use commandId+spotId; world.snapshot is spot-scoped public summary, not room snapshot; no location proof or rewards
placesParties.persistence: reviews,party visibility,shared progress and contribution receipts saved; QR capabilities/routes/subscriptions reset
placesParties.oauth: Google phone accounts use nonce-bound ID token verification when HTTPS and GAME_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID are configured; Pleos vehicle-owner OAuth stays disabled
placesParties.navigationDestination: Facility latitude/longitude retained; navigationDestination and drivingAssessment.arrival identify the mapped car-road node, not field-verified; never promotes game eligibility

deployment.dnsOwnership: Separate personal-project session; not modified automatically

collectionConsistency.inventory: Party-shared supplies. One acquisition per party+spawn+respawn cycle; separate parties are independent.
collectionConsistency.nearby: Default omits party pickups during cooldown. includeClaimed=true includes claimed history and respawnAt. Other parties keep their own items.
collectionConsistency.invalidation: snapshot.collection.revision and collection.changed refreshNearby=true; clients refresh nearby and discard stale responses. Raw GPS is not broadcast.
collectionConsistency.migration: Legacy active/departed member claims union into the party ledger; existing inventory and successful receipts preserved.
collectionConsistency.replay: Same successful command/body replays without another reward. Concurrent different members: exactly one succeeds, others ALREADY_CLAIMED.

respawn.persistence: Stored respawnAt survives restart/reconnect. UTC schedule rollover does not shorten cooldown.
respawn.cycle: nearby.spawnCycleId must be echoed on claim; stale cycle => SPAWN_CYCLE_CONFLICT. Replay of an old successful command returns its original receipt without a new reward.
respawn.notification: collection.changed and snapshot.collection.revision invalidate all party caches once at expiry. Demo fixture IDs leave collectedPickupIds at expiry.

missionEvents.join: Configure finite mission, publish/select eligible spot, join current instance before start. generic-coop-v1 is not an event mission.
missionEvents.instances: ACTIVE until target distinct-party contributions or server expiry; then COOLDOWN and a new instanceId after respawn. Prior instances/results/awards remain archived. No catch-up minting of missed cycles during downtime.
missionEvents.results: Server observes finite mission actions, persists outcome and per-stage member interactions. Reconfigure/disband cancels active run. Legacy completed rooms are imported without retroactive rewards.
missionEvents.contribution: Explicit HOST request requires instanceId, server result, pre-start binding, current event revision and parked gate. One party per event; old results cannot contribute to new cycles.
missionEvents.settlement: PENDING award per mission/run/party and shared-instance/party. HOST claims into party supplies in the same DB commit as CLAIMED flag and receipt. No cash or real-world reward. Successful identical command replays; a different command for an already claimed award conflicts.
missionEvents.clock: Global event expiry continues while a party is paused. Timer pauses bound active rooms when instance closes. Reconfigure and join a new cycle to play again.
missionEvents.notifications: mission.changed and snapshot.missionLedger; REST paginated results/rewards are authoritative. Not a hardware effect replay.
missionEvents.limits: Capacity 10000 runs, instances, command receipts. Fail closed on capacity; pages default50/max100. No automatic archive deletion or cross-party account balance.

phoneAccounts.scope: Stable phone account ID; does not grant CAR_HOST or vehicle authority.

credentials.gameToken: PARTY_PLAY, approved room membership only; account resume rotates the old game token
credentials.googleCredential: Google-signed ID token with one-use server nonce. Provider access/refresh tokens are not retained.

phoneAccounts.joining: QR URL fragment -> preview -> phone guest/Google login -> account invitation accept -> target HOST approval -> room-scoped WS
phoneAccounts.switch: expectedActivePartyId + confirmSwitch, old participation stays until target approval. Atomic removal/archive from old room and activation in target. One active membership across account devices. Cancel/removal before approval retains old party.

dataOwnership.personal: Profile, identity mapping, membership history and own mission participation summaries
dataOwnership.party: Supplies, reward awards, mission progress, vehicle state; never copied into a personal wallet or moved with a user
dataOwnership.vehicle: Existing native HOST token and fresh telemetry. Google phone login is not Pleos owner consent.

phoneAccounts.guestRecovery: Resume/refresh requires the account token. Lost guest token or private browser storage cannot recover identity across devices. Google LINK keeps the userId; an existing Google identity collision returns conflict without automatic merging.
phoneAccounts.transport: Account APIs require trusted HTTPS whenever public origin is HTTPS. Google remains disabled without HTTPS + client ID. Current HTTP demo guest testing is not a production Google deployment.
phoneAccounts.configuration: Generic GAME_* values; display name and URLs are not database identity keys. Protocol/service compatibility identifiers remain stable.
phoneAccounts.migration: Account-aware checkpoint format2 accepts legacy1. Down-revision code must not rewrite format2; deliberate backup restoration is needed for downgrade.

phoneWebClient.authFlow: GIS JavaScript popup callback, server challenge nonce and verified ID token exchange; no redirect URI or client secret
phoneWebClient.accountStorage: API-origin-scoped tab sessionStorage; explicit guest creation; no automatic identity replacement on failure
phoneWebClient.playStorage: memory only; PHONE_ACCOUNT is never game WS auth
phoneWebClient.resume: explicit party-ticket; pending approval completion connects once; 4412 never auto-resumes
phoneWebClient.qr: URL fragment removed before external SDK load; preview, explicit switch consent, HOST approval
phoneWebClient.configuration: GAME_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in private environment, exposed public ID through client-config/challenge; GAME_* URLs remain configurable

vehicleWebMock.transport: Actual CAR_HOST REST+WS, QR120s and PHONE_ACCOUNT/approved PARTY_PLAY; no new REST endpoints
vehicleWebMock.signals: SIMULATED_API_CLIENTS, foreground/gear and 2s heartbeat, no SDK or actual actuation
vehicleWebMock.qr: Locally hosted MIT qrcode-generator 2.0.4; only invite fragment, never HOST/account/play token
vehicleWebMock.iframe: same-origin frame-ancestors only; parent message origin and exact child source verified; only invite URL and non-authoritative stage passed
vehicleWebMock.secrets: HOST access key cleared after enrollment; host credential memory only and never passed to parent/phone
vehicleWebMock.google: Actual configured GIS login in phone; account selection/consent by user; no new client or global branding change
vehicleWebMock.enrollment: Public demo GAME_TEST_ACCESS_KEY is empty; client-config.sessionAccessKeyRequired=false hides the key field. Existing role/party/session/observer authority is unchanged.

pleosEmulatorViews.status: /vehicles/status.json on the separate CT317 viewer service
pleosEmulatorViews.capacity: Only 1 constrained 3GiB/1600x900 demo AVD validated; official guide is 4GiB and host cannot sustain 2-3 with current workloads
pleosEmulatorViews.authority: Read-only VNC server and browser; no public ADB, control, start/stop or arbitrary-file endpoint
pleosEmulatorViews.freshness: Current Android user (10), app-private snapshot under10s; only room ID/state, counts, gear and UX are public

nativeNavigation.auth: Current CAR_HOST socket; increasing reportSeq; approved party snapshots only
nativeNavigation.geometry: TripSummary routePoints are POI summaries, not road polylines. SDK ownership clears previous demo geometry.
nativeNavigation.freshness: Report expires after10s; position sample and age must remain within10s; reconnect/restart resets state
nativeNavigation.persistence: SDK coordinates and navigation state excluded from SQLite checkpoints
nativeNavigation.callbacks: Request success alone is not route readiness; callback delivery depends on the navigation app. Destination changes can be detected from SDK destination responses.
nativeNavigation.screen: Existing game UX gates preserved; no APP_MAPS or driving exemption
